title: LLM能否利用世界知识进行事件预测？
summary: 研究探讨LLM能否利用预训练世界知识进行时间事件预测，提出通过自然语言描述事件并将事件语义与预测空间分离的接口设计，使LLM成为有效的事件预测器。发布DescribeEvent基准，涵盖7个数据集、6个领域约15万事件，实验表明强LLM在描述和符号标签辅助下显著优于无描述变体及非LLM基线。
summary_en: This work asks whether LLMs can access their pretrained world knowledge for temporal event prediction. The authors argue it is an interface problem and propose grounding events in natural-language descriptions while separating event semantics from the prediction space. They introduce DescribeEvent, a benchmark of ~150K events across seven datasets and six domains. Capable LLMs substantially benefit from descriptions and symbolic labels, outperforming description-free variants and non-LLM baselines, while weaker models gain little.
